title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线不是模型又多了几个版本，而是 agent 开始从工具变成基础设施：Aaron Levie 描述了从执行任务到接收目标、持续迭代的下一代工作方式；Guillermo Rauch 把 agent 之间的 message board 做成了新的协作原语；Notion 创始人 Ivan Zhao 则提醒我们，AI 时代真正耐久的不是 UI 或 procedural logic，而是数据、上下文和语义。另一边，Thariq 的判断很克制：好软件依然来自强烈而经过思考的意见。

archive.title: Agent 原语日报
archive.desc: Agent 正从一次性回答器走向能协作、迭代并长期运行的系统，而数据与上下文成为更耐久的底座。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-19 source feeds.

sections.title: Agents Become Systems / Agent 开始成为系统
sections.desc: 下一代 agent 不只回答问题，而是围绕目标设计、执行、测试和持续优化结果。

rewrite: Aaron Levie, CEO of Box, sees agents moving through another level of capability: from quick answers, to orchestrated task sets, and soon to systems that receive goals instead of step-by-step instructions.

Those systems could design a solution, test and deploy it, then keep improving it from ongoing execution. Engineering will likely lead, but the same pattern could improve client onboarding, risk reduction, and security across knowledge work.
original: We’ll soon be able to give agents a set of goals, and they can go out and design the best solution for that goal, while also continuously improving it based on the ongoing execution of whatever it built.
These autonomous systems will be able to take on a set of goals, design the best outcome, test and iterate, deploy, and then optimize whatever it built on an ongoing basis.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，agent 正在进入下一阶段：从快速给答案，到在任务集合里被编排，再到很快可以只接收目标，而不是逐步指令。
这类系统会自己设计方案、测试、部署，再根据持续执行的结果不断优化。工程领域可能最先成熟，但客户 onboarding、风险控制和安全也会被同一套模式改写。
original: 我们很快就能给 agent 一组目标，让它自己设计最好的方案，并根据它所构建的东西持续执行的结果不断改进。
这些自主系统可以接收目标、设计最优结果、测试和迭代、部署，然后持续优化它构建的东西。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch argues that message boards are becoming a primitive for multi-agent systems. Think 'headless Slack' for agents: a model-, harness-, and hosting-agnostic place where agents can coordinate without a human prompting every move.

He sees this as infrastructure for software factories, self-optimizing systems, and scientific research, where a human prompt is only the seed and large numbers of agents operate in a decentralized way.
original: We built a message board infrastructure primitive. You can think of it as "headless Slack" (or remember IRC?) for agents.

This is an important building block for software factories, self-optimizing systems, and scientific research, where the human prompting is just the seed of the system, and millions of agents can operate in a decentralized fashion.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为，message board 正在成为多 agent 系统的基础原语。可以把它理解成 agent 的「headless Slack」：不依赖特定模型、harness 或 hosting，让 agent 在没有人类逐步提示的情况下自行协作。
他把这看作 software factory、自优化系统和科学研究的基础设施：人的 prompt 只是种子，更多 agent 可以以去中心化的方式运行。
original: 我们构建了一个 message board 基础设施原语。你可以把它理解成 agent 的 headless Slack（还记得 IRC 吗？）。
这是 software factory、自优化系统和科学研究的重要 building block：人的 prompt 只是系统的种子，数百万 agent 可以去中心化运行。

cards.authorTag: Notion Founder · AI & I by Every

rewrite: Notion founder Ivan Zhao's durable thesis is that AI makes interfaces and procedural logic easier to replace, which makes data, context, and semantics more valuable. Notion's role is increasingly to hold that context, open it to different agents, and give human teams guardrails around it.

He is enthusiastic about vibe coding as a return to software as a medium everyone can write, but draws a line between freedom to modify tools and the value of a well-crafted product someone else has thought through.
original: What’s really important is the data. How do you hold your data? How do you hold your context, your semantics? What’s important to you, to your business?
AI agent opened up both of them... You can vibe code a UI, whatever you want them to do. So in some sense, we are not married to that.

rewrite: Notion 创始人 Ivan Zhao 的核心判断是：AI 让 UI 和 procedural logic 更容易被替换，于是数据、上下文和语义反而更有价值。Notion 越来越像是在保管这些 context，把它开放给不同 agent，同时为人类团队提供协作护栏。
他支持 vibe coding，把它看成软件重新成为人人都能书写的媒介；但他也区分了「有权修改工具」和「一个经过充分思考、值得直接使用的好产品」。
original: 真正重要的是数据。你如何保存数据？如何保存 context 和 semantics？对你、对你的业务来说，什么才是重要的？
AI agent 同时打开了这两件事……你可以 vibe code 一个 UI，让它做任何你想让它做的事。所以某种程度上，我们并不依附于那个 UI。

sections.title: The Product Boundary / 产品边界重新出现
sections.desc: 能生成软件，不等于知道什么软件值得被长期使用。

rewrite: Thariq, formerly of Claude Code, pushes back on the idea that everyone will generate their own software. His reason is simple: good software is a set of strong opinions, and most people would rather use something that another person has thought through deeply.
That is not an argument against AI coding. It is a reminder that generation is only one part of product design; deciding what should exist, and what should be left out, remains hard.
original: this is one of those reasons why I don't think most people will really generate their own software
good software is a set of strong opinions and I'd rather have something that's been really thought through by someone else

rewrite: 前 Claude Code 成员 Thariq 不太相信大多数人最终会自己生成软件。理由很简单：好软件是一组强烈的产品判断，而多数人更愿意使用别人已经认真想过的东西。
这不是反对 AI coding，而是在提醒：生成只是产品设计的一部分，决定什么应该存在、什么应该被删掉，依然很难。
original: 这也是我不认为大多数人真的会生成自己的软件的原因之一。
好软件是一组强烈的意见，我更愿意使用别人真正认真想过的东西。

rewrite: Google Labs' Project Genie is framed as a world-building experience: create a world from one sentence, edit it while inside it, and use an agent to create worlds conversationally. A gallery lets users explore and remix one another's worlds.
The notable product choice is that generation is not the end state. The world remains editable and social after creation, turning a one-shot prompt into an environment people can keep shaping.
original: Create a world from one sentence, then change it while you’re standing inside.
Prompt mid-session to edit your world live; create worlds conversationally with the help of a new agent; explore & remix other users' worlds in the gallery.

rewrite: Google Labs 把 Project Genie 做成了一个持续构建世界的体验：用一句话创建世界，身处其中时实时修改，也可以借助 agent 通过对话创建；用户还能在 gallery 里探索和 remix 别人的世界。
值得注意的是，生成不是终点。世界在创建后仍然可编辑、可分享，让一次性 prompt 变成一个可以持续塑造的环境。
original: 用一句话创建一个世界，然后在你身处其中时改变它。
在 session 中途通过 prompt 实时编辑世界；借助新 agent 通过对话创建世界；在 gallery 里探索和 remix 其他用户的世界。

sections.title: Infrastructure and Economics / 基础设施与经济账
sections.desc: Agent 的规模化不仅需要新的协作原语，也会把 compute、token 和供应商整合推到台前。

rewrite: Guillermo Rauch says he is being pitched an inference neocloud roughly every two days, even as Vercel's AI Gateway token demand has compounded at about 40% month over month since the beginning of the year.

His reconciliation is that compute is becoming a new economic layer and tokens a new energy unit. Expect more expansion first, then consolidation as scale, security, enterprise requirements, capital, and regulation start to matter.
original: AI Gateway token demand on Vercel has been ~40% MoM compounded since the beginning of the year.
One way to reconcile this is that compute is the new economy, and tokens the new energy unit.

rewrite: Guillermo Rauch 说，平均每两天就有人向他推介一家 inference neocloud；与此同时，Vercel AI Gateway 的 token 需求自年初以来按月复合增长约 40%。
他的解释是：compute 正成为新的经济层，token 则像新的能源单位。短期还会继续扩张，之后会因为规模效应、安全、企业要求、资本和监管而进入整合。
original: 自年初以来，Vercel 上 AI Gateway 的 token 需求按月复合增长约 40%。
一种解释是，compute 是新的经济，token 是新的能源单位。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad points to a surprisingly concrete interface for multi-agent work: message boards. Looking at how agents communicate during the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident made him think of Replit Missions, where the coordination itself is visible.
original: With Replit Missions you can see how the agents are coordinating and talking.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 指出了多 agent 工作里一个很具体的界面：message board。他在观察 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件中 agent 的沟通方式时，想到了 Replit Missions，因为在那里可以直接看到 agent 如何协调和交流。
original: 通过 Replit Missions，你可以看到 agent 是如何协调和交流的。

sections.title: Builders' Operating Rules / Builder 的操作守则
sections.desc: 在工具快速变化的时代，长期复利、雄心和真实的技术难题仍然是稀缺资源。

rewrite: Zara Zhang argues for compounding distribution over one-day virality: a little visibility every week is better than one massive spike. The practical implication is to build a system that consistently delivers high-quality content over a long period.
original: Instead of being massively viral for 1 day, it's much better to be just a little bit viral every week, and watch it compound
Build a system that consistently delivers high-quality content over a long period of time

rewrite: Zara Zhang 更相信分发的复利，而不是一天爆红：每周获得一点点传播，比一次巨大的峰值更好。落实到执行，就是建立一个能长期稳定产出高质量内容的系统。
original: 与其只火一天，不如每周都有一点传播，看着它不断复利。
建立一个能长期稳定交付高质量内容的系统。

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari's fundraising advice is to lead with the ambitious second- or third-order outcome. If everything works, what becomes true? Put that answer on slide one, then earn the right to it by showing how the company gets there.
original: ambition is what’s being rewarded right now. what do you believe to be true if everything you laid out works?
put ‘this’ in the pitch in the first slide and walk the investor how you get to ‘this’ by building what you’re building

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari 给融资中的创始人的建议是：把二阶、三阶结果放到最前面。如果一切顺利，什么事情会变成真的？把答案放在第一页，再说明公司如何一步步配得上那个结果。
original: 现在被奖励的是雄心：如果你说的一切都实现了，你相信什么会变成真的？
把‘这个结果’放在 pitch 第一页，然后告诉投资人你如何通过正在做的事走到那里。
